chunks.title: About Me
chunks.content: About Me Applied AI Engineer for AI Automation, AI/ML, and LLM product roles. Reliable AI automation. Product-minded engineering. Computer vision depth. I build applied AI systems that take research into usable products and workflows. My focus is computer vision, real-time inference, retrieval-augmented generation, and LLM-enabled automation backed by APIs and practical reliability controls. My flagship work is Shifaa, a privacy-first patient-monitoring platform. I worked on its real-time seizure-detection pipeline using Vision Transformers, Graph Neural Networks, OpenPose, ONNX Runtime, C++, and Python. I hold a dual degree in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence from Ain Shams University and the University of East London (Class of 2026, GPA: 3.3/4.0). At Cultiv Bureau, I apply the same mindset to AI automation: n8n workflows, RAG, CRM integrations, APIs, webhooks, and production debugging. Computer Vision Healthcare AI RAG AI Automation Real-Time Inference

chunks.title: Featured Projects
chunks.content: Featured Projects Flagship AI systems presented as compact case studies for fast technical review. Graduation Project | Healthcare AI Shifaa - AI-Based Patient Monitoring Platform Shifaa team at the ASU Graduation Project Expo Production-grade, privacy-first hospital monitoring platform unifying a grounded medical AI assistant with real-time detection for cardiac arrhythmia, patient falls, and epileptic seizures. 96.69% AUROC 90.18% F1 37+ FPS PyTorch OpenCV ONNX Runtime C++ Python ViViT GNN OpenPose Repo Demo Paper Problem Hospitals need fast, on-premises patient monitoring without leaking sensitive data. Solution A role-aware interface with three detection pipelines and a grounded medical assistant. Architecture Series-gated ViViT + GNN seizure pipeline with OpenPose, ONNX Runtime, C++, and Python. Results 96.69% AUROC, 90.18% F1-score, 37+ FPS, and pre-clinical seizure alerts. Impact Designed for privacy-first, fully on-premises hospital deployment and presented to faculty, industry professionals, and recruiters at the ASU GP Expo. Future Work Clinical validation, alert workflow hardening, and broader hospital integrations. 1st Place | Computer Vision Fruit & Food Segmentation and Calorie Estimation Segmentation, classification, few-shot recognition, and calorie estimation using EfficientNet-B4 + DeepLabV3+. 97.69% Val IoU PyTorch EfficientNet-B4 DeepLabV3+ Few-shot Recognition Code Live Demo Problem Food analysis needs object-level recognition before calories can be estimated reliably. Solution Segment food regions, classify items, support few-shot recognition, then estimate calories. Results 97.69% Validation IoU and 1st Place in the Ain Shams CV Course Competition. Lessons Strong segmentation quality is the foundation for trustworthy downstream nutrition estimates. Medical Imaging Liver Tumor AI - Real-Time Detection & Segmentation PyTorch + U-Net liver tumor segmentation pipeline for unseen patients using strict patient-level validation. 95% Accuracy 91.7% Dice PyTorch U-Net Medical AI Segmentation Live Demo Code Problem Medical segmentation can look strong while leaking patient data across splits. Solution Patient-independent validation with a U-Net segmentation pipeline. Results 95% accuracy and 91.7% Dice score. Impact Healthcare AI proof point with a deployed demo and reproducible code. NLP Research Article Summarizer Chatbot Conversational summarization and question-generation chatbot using Gemini 2.5 Flash API. Gemini API Streamlit NLP Question Generation ROUGE Evaluation Live Demo Code Paper Problem Readers need fast, contextual summaries and follow-up questions from long articles. Solution A Streamlit chatbot that summarizes, extracts topics, and generates context-aware questions. Research Built during the MAHE internship and connected to an NLP summarization paper. Future Work Add richer evaluation dashboards and source-grounded answer tracing. Speech AI / LLM Product CohereVoice Studio An advanced speech-recognition, broadcast-subtitle, and meeting-intelligence suite with Egyptian Arabic-aware model routing. Cohere Transcribe Streamlit pyannote.audio wav2vec 2.0 FFmpeg Code Capabilities Generates broadcast-ready subtitles, multilingual transcripts, speaker labels, and structured meeting notes. Architecture Routes media by language, then combines ASR, diarization, word alignment, subtitle splitting, and translation. Delivery Available through a Streamlit studio and a scriptable CLI for repeatable media-processing workflows. LLM Product Engineering Grounded Portfolio Assistant A portfolio assistant that answers from verified CV, portfolio, and GitHub context with server-side OpenAI calls. OpenAI API Grounded Retrieval Serverless API Route Tests Diagnostics Code Try Assistant Scope Answers only from verified professional material instead of open-ended web knowledge. Reliability Uses route tests, provider diagnostics, conversation context, and a verified fallback path. Lesson Grounding and deterministic handling matter as much as the model response in recruiter-facing AI products. AI Automation Sanitized n8n Workflow Templates Public, credential-free workflow templates that demonstrate the building blocks behind LLM-enabled automation. n8n LLM Workflows REST APIs Webhooks JSON Validation View Templates Purpose Share inspectable workflow patterns without exposing customer data, credentials, or employer-specific logic. Focus Automation composition, API/webhook integration, structured data handling, and failure-aware workflow design. Relevance Supports an Applied AI and AI Automation engineering profile with a public implementation artifact.
